sections.title: Mount Definition
sections.text: scheme is pin-slot, two-pin or 2-2-2. pin and slot are {x,y} locating datum positions. holes is {diameter,clearance?,positions:[{x,y},...]}. boss {diameter,height} is a connector standoff; insert {type,outerDiameter,innerDiameter,length} is optional. material and process are provenance. The recipe creates the pin and slot locating datums and declares the clearance hole pattern and boss as feature prescriptions with a mate-fit analysis.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, scheme, locatingDofConstrained, overConstrained, pin, slot, holes{diameter,clearance,positions}, boss, insert, material, process, recipe:mount, atomic:false, featurePlan, mateFit, checks, regeneration}. status is fail when the scheme over-constrains the PCB (every hole tight). Locating datums are created; holes/boss are declared feature prescriptions (recipeRegeneration).

examples.label: Pin+slot PCB mount with connector standoff
examples.requires: Native component; PcbMount and PcbMount__pin/__slot names unused.
examples.output: result.locatingDofConstrained is 3 and result.overConstrained is false; result.pin and result.slot are datum refs.

verified: Locating datums created; holes/boss as declared prescriptions
bugs: Holes/boss are feature prescriptions, not live native features

sections.title: Mount Mate-Fit Check
sections.text: holes is an array of {diameter,clearance,x?,y?}. The check flags a PCB fixed through every hole (thermal over-constraint) and verifies connector support when connector.supported is true and a standoff/support is present.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, scheme, overConstrained, locatingDofConstrained, holes, checks[]}. status is fail when over-constrained or a declared connector lacks support; connector support is notEvaluated when no connector is declared.

examples.label: Located PCB with clearance holes and connector support
examples.output: result.overConstrained is false and result.checks report pass for over-constraint and connector-support.

verified: Over-constraint detected when every hole is tight

sections.title: Fastener Clamp Stack
sections.text: screw has length and threadLength (positive, threadLength <= length). stack is an array of clamped parts with thickness. Engagement is threadLength minus the clamped stack. receptacle {kind:nut|tapped|insert, threadLength?, depth?} supplies the mating thread and (for blind tapped/insert) the bottoming depth. bottoming clearance is receptacle.depth minus the screw protrusion (length - clampedLength). torque is a declared datum, never derived from diameter. tool {diameter,recess?} checks access against the recess.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, screw, clampedLength, parts, engagement, receptacle, bottoming, torque, torqueStatus, toolAccess, note}. status is fail when engagement is not positive. bottoming is null when no blind depth is declared; toolAccess is null when no tool is declared.

examples.label: M3 screw clamping 5.6 mm into an insert
examples.output: result.clampedLength is 5.6 mm and result.engagement is 4.4 mm; result.bottoming.clearance is 1.6 mm (not bottomed).

verified: Torque declared, never derived from diameter
bugs: Access reported only when tool declared

sections.title: Fastener Stack Validation
sections.text: Validates engagement against a declared minimumEngagement, bottoming against the declared receptacle depth and tool access against the declared tool recess. Missing requirements are notEvaluated, never fabricated from diameter.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, engagement, clampedLength, bottoming, toolAccess, checks[]}. status is fail when engagement is below the declared minimum, the screw bottoms out, or the tool does not fit the recess.

examples.label: Engagement and access check
examples.output: result.engagement is 4.4 mm (>= 4 mm) and result.checks report pass for engagement.

verified: Bottoming and access from declared data

sections.title: Native Fastener Measurement
sections.text: Supply schemaVersion:1 and mode:native with native {schemaVersion:1,frame:{space,component},tolerance:{axisOffset,axisAngle,minimumEngagement?},screw:{axis?,headBearing?,tip?,threadStart?,threadEnd?},receptacle:{kind,axis?,threadStart?,threadEnd?,bottom?},layers?:[{id?,start?,end?}]}. Refs are existing native axis/edge and point/vertex refs resolved in one explicit assembly or component-local frame. Missing refs produce unknown coverage; they are never replaced by declared dimensions.

sections.title: Measurements and Return Contract
sections.text: Returns {schemaVersion:1,operation:'fastener.measured-check',mode:'native',status,frame,units,nativeMeasurements,declaredEvidence,toolAccess,checks,limitations}. Native axial thread-boundary overlap is not exact helical flank contact. Bottoming uses selected blind-hole bottom and screw tip; protrusion uses selected layer endpoints; alignment uses measured axis refs and declared tolerances. Each measurement identifies sourceRef, sourceVersion:1, document identity when available, frame and coverage.

sections.title: Declared and Tool Evidence
sections.text: Optional declaredEvidence is an unchanged fastener.stack/check request in its original component frame and units; it remains a separate comparison and is never substituted into native measurements. Tool access requires at least one selected native solid-body ref for a pass; selected obstacles are measured by conservative axis-aligned bounds and passed to the existing sampled tool.access implementation. This is not an exhaustive scene scan. Caller point/radius or box obstacles remain separately labeled declared evidence; neither coverage is a continuous collision proof.

sections.title: Qualification Boundary
sections.text: Mock/fake SDK tests verify the offline contract, not Fusion kernel semantics. Real synthetic-document positive/negative qualification and required restore remain blocked until explicit user approval.

examples.label: Native engagement plus separate legacy comparison
examples.requires: Read-only native references; selected document; occurrence-qualified refs for placed instances.
examples.output: result.nativeMeasurements.measurements.actualEngagement reports the native axial interval overlap in mm with provenance; result.declaredEvidence retains the independent legacy calculator result.

verified: Native interval/bottoming/alignment/protrusion evidence remains separate from declared legacy calculations
Tool access delegates to existing sequence implementation
CLI and MCP use the canonical prepared Python artifact
bugs: Exact thread-flank engagement is not available; only selected axial boundary interval overlap is reported
Real Fusion synthetic-document qualification and restoration require separate explicit consent

sections.title: Fastener Schedule
sections.text: fasteners is an array of {id,torque?,process?,material?,vendor?,stack?,screw?}. The schedule reports declared torque/process/material per fastener and flags entries with missing data rather than fabricating torque or fit from diameter.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, count, rows[], missingData[], note}. status is unknown when any fastener lacks torque, process or material (missingData lists those ids); otherwise pass.

examples.label: Complete two-fastener schedule
examples.output: result.missingData is empty and result.status is pass.

sections.title: Bearing Stack
sections.text: rings {inner{bore?,width?},outer{od?,width?}}, journal (shaft diameter) and seat (housing bore) define the fits. fits {shaft,housing} are declared classes; shaftClearance/housingClearance are signed clearances (negative = interference). shoulder {inner?,outer?} selects the fixed ring. arrangement is fixed-floating, fixed-fixed or floating. No default preload is assumed; axial load chain runs through the fixed ring shoulder.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, rings{innerBore,outerOd}, journal, seat, shaftFit, housingFit, radialInternalClearance, arrangement, fixedRing, preload, retainer, axialLoad, axialLoadChain, checks[]}. preload is 'none declared'. fixedRing is undeclared (unknown) when no shoulder is given.

examples.label: Fixed-floating pair with inner ring located
examples.output: result.fixedRing is inner and result.preload is 'none declared'.

verified: Axial load chain through the fixed ring
bugs: No bearing life or stiffness claim

sections.title: Shaft / Hub Interface
sections.text: shaft {type:D-flat|keyed|round,d,flat?:{depth},key?:{width,height}} mates hub {bore,boreType?,splitClampGap?,shoulders?,retainer?}. A D-flat shaft must mate a D-flat bore, never a round hole; a keyed shaft must mate a keyed bore. splitClampGap must be positive when clamping. shoulders/retainer provide axial retention.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, shaftType, matedFeatures[], seatedLength, checks[]}. status is fail when a D-flat/key mate is missing, the split-clamp gap is nonpositive, or axial retention is absent.

examples.label: D-flat shaft into a D-flat clamp hub
examples.output: result.matedFeatures includes the D-flat mate and result.checks report pass.

verified: D-flat shaft requires a D-flat bore, not a round hole
bugs: No torque transmission or strength claim

sections.title: Bayonet Retention
sections.text: lugs {count,width,height} with an insertion stroke and rotation. capture {depth} retains axially; clearances {axial?,radial?} must be nonnegative. The assembly path is insert -> rotate -> capture and the unlock path is counter-rotate -> retract.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, lugs, stroke, rotation, ramps, stops, capture, clearances, assemblyPath, unlockPath, checks[]}. status is fail when capture depth is not positive or the radial clearance is nonpositive.

examples.label: Three-lug bayonet with capture
examples.output: result.assemblyPath is insert -> rotate -> capture and result.checks report pass.

bugs: No retention force or release-safety certification

sections.title: Snap Definition
sections.text: geometry {length,width,thickness,engagementDepth,angle?} with a material {name,modulus?,yieldStrength?}. retention is an optional retention style. This is the shape definition; deflection/strain/force come from snap.evaluate with a declared modulus. No material default is assumed.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, geometry, material, retention, shape, note}. A cantilever beam snap with rectangular section; dimensions in mm.

examples.label: ABS cantilever snap definition
examples.output: result.shape is a cantilever beam snap and result.material.modulus is 2.1 GPa.

verified: Shape definition only; no material default

sections.title: Snap Beam Evaluation
sections.text: Linear elastic small-deflection beam: deflection = P L^3 / (3 E I) for cantilever (192 E I for fixed-fixed), I = w t^3 / 12, strain = 3 t d / (2 L^2). material.modulus is required (MPa/GPa/N/mm^2); yieldStrength enables the strain check. The model scope is explicit; there is no fatigue-life claim.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, support, stiffness (N/mm), engagementForce (N), deflection, strain, stress (MPa), model, scope, checks[]}. status is fail when stress exceeds the declared yield strength; without yieldStrength the strain check is notEvaluated.

examples.label: ABS cantilever 0.6 mm deflection
examples.output: result.stiffness is about 3*2100*0.333/1000 N/mm and result.stress is about 3*2100*1*0.6/(2*100) MPa.

verified: Explicit model scope, no fatigue-life claim

sections.title: Hose Barb
sections.text: tubeId < tubeOd and 0 < bore <= tubeId. barbs is an array of {crest,root,length} with crest > root >= tubeOd. The recipe revolves a stepped closed profile about the hose axis (default X). Seating is checked as radial interference (crest - tubeId)/2 per barb; channel continuity requires a positive through-bore. Opposing barbs across a short hose are flagged as a declared collision risk.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result = {schemaVersion:1, feature, bodies, healthState, message, helpers, tubeId, tubeOd, bore, barbs[], clampZone, blend, seating[], opposingBarbCollision, checks[], recipe:hose-barb, atomic:false, regeneration}. status is fail when any barb has nonpositive interference or the channel is not continuous. Seating is geometric interference, not a leak-tightness proof.

examples.label: Two-barb hose fitting
examples.requires: Native component; Barb and Barb__section names unused.
examples.output: result.checks report pass for channel-continuity and each barb seating with 1.5 mm radial interference.

bugs: Seating is geometric interference, not leak-tightness
